tools.name: aios_status
tools.description: Return public AIOS discovery state. Free; no product result.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List public AIOS capabilities and availability. Free.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Describe one stable public AIOS capability ID. Free.

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Return Public Discovery free state and intended introductory paid pricing. Free.

tools.name: preflight_request
tools.description: Check bounded capability readiness without returning the substantive result. Free.

tools.name: list_guidance_sources
tools.description: Use when an agent first needs to see which UK employment-guidance classes G05 can verify. Lists only the monitored GOV.UK source set; do not use as legal advice or for unrelated GOV.UK content. Free.

tools.name: search_guidance_sources
tools.description: Use when ordinary employment/payroll language must be mapped to a monitored G05 source before checking current official guidance. Searches only the bounded GOV.UK source set. Free.

tools.name: check_guidance_status
tools.description: Use before answering or acting when current official GOV.UK employment guidance materially matters. Returns current preserved verification status, freshness and provenance for one or all monitored sources. Free.

tools.name: get_guidance_changes
tools.description: Use when the task asks whether monitored official UK employment guidance changed, what changed, or whether earlier retained guidance differs from the latest preserved state. Free.

tools.name: get_verification_evidence
tools.description: Use when an agent needs evidence for a consequential answer: authoritative source identity, verification time, provenance and a bounded excerpt from a monitored GOV.UK employment source. Free.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_guidance_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use before answering or acting when current official GOV.UK employment guidance materially matters. Returns current preserved verification status, freshness and…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
